ai_executive_summary: We are pivoting to 'Relatable Shock' to minimize cognitive load, replacing abstract science with immediate, high-shareability 'I-do-that-too' content. self_learning_reflection: Previous high-concept science content hit a ceiling due to complexity. Audience data suggests that 'Relatable Shock' hooks significantly increase retention rates because they require zero prior knowledge and offer immediate emotional satisfaction.
